description: This file defines the AutoFilter class used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to manage autofiltering of worksheet data ranges, including applying filter rules, hiding/showing rows, and handling various filter types and dynamic date rules.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Represents and manages autofiltering for a specific worksheet range, including setting filter rules, applying filters, and controlling row visibility based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getEvaluated
methods.description: Returns whether the autoFilter has been evaluated.

methods.name: setEvaluated
methods.description: Sets the evaluated state of the autoFilter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new AutoFilter object, setting the range and optionally the worksheet.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet associated with this AutoFilter.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Associates this AutoFilter with a parent worksheet.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the current autofilter range.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the autofilter range and validates its correctness, removing invalid column rules.

methods.name: setRangeToMaxRow
methods.description: Adjusts the range to extend to the worksheet's highest row.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns all columns that have filter rules applied.

methods.name: testColumnInRange
methods.description: Validates if a column is within the autofilter range and returns its offset.

methods.name: getColumnOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a specified column within the autofilter range.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a filter rule object for a specific column.

methods.name: getColumnByOffset
methods.description: Gets an AutoFilter column object by its offset.

methods.name: setColumn
methods.description: Sets or replaces a filter rule for a specific column.

methods.name: clearColumn
methods.description: Removes any filter rule from a specific column.

methods.name: shiftColumn
methods.description: Moves a filter rule from one column to another within the range.

methods.name: filterTestInSimpleDataSet
methods.description: Checks if a cell value exists in a simple set of filter values.

methods.name: filterTestInDateGroupSet
methods.description: Checks if a date value belongs to a specified date group.

methods.name: filterTestInCustomDataSet
methods.description: Tests if a cell value matches custom filter rules, supporting operators and wildcards.

methods.name: filterTestInPeriodDateSet
methods.description: Checks if a date value falls within a set of months.

methods.name: makeDateObject
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from specified year, month, day, and optional time components.

methods.name: dynamicLastMonth
methods.description: Calculates date range for last month.

methods.name: firstDayOfQuarter
methods.description: Returns the DateTime of the first day of the current quarter.

methods.name: dynamicLastQuarter
methods.description: Calculates date range for last quarter.

methods.name: dynamicLastWeek
methods.description: Calculates date range for last week.

methods.name: dynamicLastYear
methods.description: Calculates date range for last year.

methods.name: dynamicNextMonth
methods.description: Calculates date range for next month.

methods.name: dynamicNextQuarter
methods.description: Calculates date range for next quarter.

methods.name: dynamicNextWeek
methods.description: Calculates date range for next week.

methods.name: dynamicNextYear
methods.description: Calculates date range for next year.

methods.name: dynamicThisMonth
methods.description: Calculates date range for the current month.

methods.name: dynamicThisQuarter
methods.description: Calculates date range for the current quarter.

methods.name: dynamicThisWeek
methods.description: Calculates date range for this week.

methods.name: dynamicThisYear
methods.description: Calculates date range for the current year.

methods.name: dynamicToday
methods.description: Calculates date range for today.

methods.name: dynamicTomorrow
methods.description: Calculates date range for tomorrow.

methods.name: dynamicYearToDate
methods.description: Calculates date range from start of year to today.

methods.name: dynamicYesterday
methods.description: Calculates date range for yesterday.

methods.name: dynamicFilterDateRange
methods.description: Converts a dynamic date rule into a date range for filtering.

methods.name: calculateTopTenValue
methods.description: Determines the top N value in a column based on current data.

methods.name: autoExtendRange
methods.description: Automatically extends a range downward until an empty row is encountered.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the AutoFilter object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the autofilter range as a string representation.
